title: The WCFM Membership – WooCommerce Memberships for Multivendor Marketplace plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored…
description: The WCFM Membership – WooCommerce Memberships for Multivendor Marketplace plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'wcfm_membership_registration_form[store_name]' parameter. This vulnerability affects all versions up to and including 2.12.0. It allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when users access the affected pages. The registration endpoint is accessible without authentication due to a publicly available nonce on the /vendor-register/ page.
